title: CoasterBench
excerpt: A benchmark in which language models design roller coasters that RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 builds, tests, and rates.
content_html:
A benchmark in which language models design roller coasters that RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 builds, tests, and rates.

how it worksgithub
Each round a model submits a track program. OpenRCT2 builds it, runs a test train, and returns ratings and a screenshot; the reported score is excitement.

Pieces are placed through the same validated action path the game uses for player input, so an impossible curve or an open circuit fails as it would in-game. Intensity above 10 suppresses excitement, a crash disqualifies the ride, and designs close to the stock library scale toward zero. Ratings come from the game, not from a model. Modes: design — design mode — models build from scratch. library — library mode — models may search the stock track design library, which measures retrieval and adaptation; copies score zero. open note — open-note condition — the agent is given the engine source it is scored by, so it can read the ratings code instead of guessing; scores are not comparable with black-box runs. full protocol →
